reason: At work I make my own Turkish coffee for free, so I would not come here for my daily cup. But I need a quiet seat with Wi-Fi to study for my exams in the evenings, and a 2-dinar Turkish coffee to sit until late is something I could try a couple of times instead of Qahwa BLK.
objection: Qahwa BLK is right there and I already know it. Most of the menu is 3 to 4 dinars, which is too much for me to spend often, and I don't know yet if they will let me sit for hours with one cheap coffee or if the Wi-Fi is any good.
would_change_my_mind: A study deal, like a free refill or a cheaper second Turkish coffee or tea for people staying to study in the evening, would make me switch from Qahwa BLK and come every week.
